numbers.title: The Leader
numbers.personality: Born under the Sun, Moolank 1 carries natural authority, pride and a pioneering spirit. You prefer to lead rather than follow, and you carry a quiet dignity that others notice even when you say little.

numbers.love: In love you are loyal and generous in love, though you must guard against dominating your partner. For marriage, you expect respect and devotion, and marriage grows steadier when you listen as much as you lead.
numbers.finance: You earn well through initiative and status, and tend to spend generously on family and image.
numbers.education: You do best when allowed to choose subjects independently; leadership, law and management suit you.
numbers.challenges:
Ego
Impatience
Stubbornness
Difficulty accepting advice

Offer water to the rising Sun each morning (Surya Arghya)
Chant 'Om Suryaya Namah' on Sundays
Use gold, orange or saffron tones in clothing
Treat your father figures and elders with respect

numbers.title: The Nurturer

numbers.love: In love you are tender and devoted, though prone to overthinking and emotional sensitivity. For marriage, you value emotional security and a peaceful home, and mutual reassurance keeps the bond strong.
numbers.finance: Money flows in waves, so steady savings and trusted advisors bring stability.
numbers.education: You learn best in calm, supportive settings; literature, psychology, design and the healing arts suit you.

Over-sensitivity
Indecision
Dependence on approval

Chant 'Om Chandraya Namah'

numbers.title: The Teacher

Ethical outlook

numbers.title: The Builder
numbers.personality: Linked with Rahu, Moolank 4 is practical, hardworking and often unconventional. You build through sustained effort, question inherited rules, and see angles that others miss.

Light a lamp before Goddess Durga on Saturdays
Chant 'Om Rahave Namah'

numbers.title: The Communicator
numbers.personality: Governed by Mercury, Moolank 5 is witty, versatile and quick to learn. Change and variety keep you alive, and you read situations faster than most people around you.

Offer green moong or feed a cow on Wednesdays
Chant 'Om Budhaya Namah'

Wear green on Wednesdays

numbers.title: The Artist

Vanity

Detachment

numbers.title: The Disciplined One

Chant 'Om Shanaishcharaya Namah'

Wear dark blue on Saturdays

Stamina
Honesty
A protective spirit
